purpose: S4-1b-2: shorten one DCFR iteration of the L0 trunk solver with model-preserving changes and the solver-only K4 approximation of decision P2D7, check on B3 that the approximation converges like the exact solver, and record the iteration time on B4 (Simple and General reference trees with checkdown).
reproducibility_note: Codex implemented both changes; the main loop reviewed the diffs, reran the required checks, reran B1 (average profiles bit-identical and checkpoints identical except wall times to experiments/p2-method-2026-10/trunk-solver) and re-evaluated the exact solver's 200-iteration B3 profile with l0_eval (NashConv relative difference 2.2e-13). All recorded runs are the main loop's. The B3 run used the binary of e95f45f, before the cache fix, so its wall times include the cache slowdown; its NashConv values are deterministic and unchanged by the bit-identical fix. B4 timings ran on a quiet machine (results/load.log shows no builds, tests or evaluators); other cargo processes ran during the first five minutes of the B3 run. The B3 3-iteration and B4 General 10-iteration NashConv after the cache fix were checked in Codex's runs only.
